soundness_flags.label: def:effect-image; def:singleton-minor-certificate; thm:complete-effect-image
soundness_flags.one_line: L_u and z_u contain an unbound group index g, so the proposed effect image is not a function of (W,u,v) unless the core defines the unique group g(u), or explicitly unions over qualifying groups and separately specifies singleton-mleaf cases.

soundness_flags.label: Mclass and thm:complete-effect-image
soundness_flags.one_line: The class fixes W in Q^{p×q} yet invokes Yang et al.'s probability-one/generic parameter qualification without a probability law on that rational domain; state population results over real parameters with a Zariski/Lebesgue generic qualifier, and reserve rational encoding for CompOpt bit complexity.

soundness_flags.label: ass:first-stage-coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: Chang et al.'s cited result concerns PC-based confidence intervals for a fixed causal effect, not an aligned simultaneous confidence region for an overcomplete-ICA mixing representative W; retag this as an externally supplied premise or cite a result that actually constructs such a region.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:confidence-inversion-coverage / ass:first-stage-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Existence of an honest aligned simultaneous region C_n for W is assumed, not constructed by this project.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Coverage transfer for the complete DOG effect image conditional on W belonging to the supplied C_n with the stated pointwise coverage.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2407.19426v2, 9 April 2026; inspected because the cited IJAR version was not publicly accessible
source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 13–17, Theorem 3, Algorithm 2, Proposition 6, and computational-complexity paragraph
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3 identifies the LV-SEM-ME only up to DOG equivalence under Assumptions 1, 3, and 4; Algorithm 2 enumerates center and noise choices, and DOG members are retained as the fewest-edge AOG reconstructions.
The paper enumerates observationally compatible total-causal-effect possibilities in latent-variable LiNGAM and then gives structural conditions for unique identification.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2406.02049v1, corroborating the ICML 2024 PMLR 235 publication
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 3.3 gives an iff generic total-effect criterion without graph knowledge; Theorem 3.11 gives a sound and complete O(p^3) certification algorithm for the known-graph criterion.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2405.20856v1, publicly available preprint; cited Annals version not inspected
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.3 reduces generic identification of the whole coefficient matrix in an ADMG to one maximum-flow test per node, with O(|V|^(3+o(1))) certification time.

The published work gives asymptotically correct coverage for a fixed causal-effect parameter after PC-based causal discovery by combining graph-specific estimates and intervals; it does not provide an aligned mixing-matrix confidence-region construction.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a unique group map g(u) for every intervention label, explicitly distinguish cogent-center and fixed-mleaf cases, and rewrite L_u, z_u, S_vu, and Cert_vu using it.
Separate the real-valued generic identification theorem from the rational exact-input computational theorem; replace the probability-one phrase on the rational class with a precise generic qualifier.
Either construct an aligned overcomplete-ICA confidence region or remove Chang et al. as support for ass:first-stage-coverage and present the inversion result solely as a conditional transfer lemma.

recommended_next_step: Revise the effect-image domain and generic/rational parameterization, retag the first-stage coverage premise, then return the repaired field-tier exact-image and completion-kernel proposal for review.
